We are looking for an engineer who wants to build the foundation of our new Integrations effort: the connectors that bring our customers' data from third-party systems into the Trackunit platform. The connectors you build directly support our new partnership business, one of our key goals for next year. You will be among the first developers on this project, designing a reusable architecture and working directly with the engineers behind the systems we connect to, as well as seeing customer feedback shape what you build next. You might have a couple of years or be an experienced senior engineer, either way, we would be interested in seeing your application for this role.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Shape how the work gets done. Join a new, small team set up next to an established platform team, and help define how integrations get built here.

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and we act on it quickly.

• Collaborate beyond your own codebase. You’ll have regular, technically focused conversations with developers from the systems we connect to.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll work with experienced domain experts who are open to sharing what they know, so you learn quickly.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so progress is visible fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills, just as comfortable at the edges where systems meet as inside your own codebase.

• Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular consuming data from other systems, in a microservice architecture.

• Experience designing new, reliable, reusable architecture for integrating with multiple systems. System-to-system integration experience is what we value most.

• You are comfortable discussing technical feasibility and approaches with third-party technical teams.

• You care what happens when data moves between systems, so you build with quality, observability and reliability in mind and you know quickly when something breaks.

• You are motivated by incremental delivery, enjoy getting close to the data, and like building new foundations from scratch.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Design a reusable architecture for integrating with multiple third-party systems, not one-off solutions.

• Build connectors that collect data from third-party systems, usually ERPs, mainly by consuming their REST APIs, and bring it reliably into our platform.

• Understand the data you collect and transform it into Trackunit's data model.

• Work with third-party vendors: discuss technical feasibility and approaches with their technical counterparts.

• Build with quality, observability and reliability in mind, on our microservice and event-driven architecture.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

**Automation Engineer – VELUX A/S - Thyregod

****Step into a key role where you will help shape the future of manufacturing through automation, robotics, and smart production technologies. With your technical expertise and passion for creating reliable production solutions, you could be our next Automation Engineer in Thyregod.

****Meet your future team

**You will become part of the Project Engineering team in Thyregod, working closely with colleagues across engineering, production, maintenance, and external suppliers. The team is responsible for developing, implementing, and maturing production technologies that support efficient, stable, and safe manufacturing operations.

As our automation specialist, you will play a central role in automation-related projects and production development initiatives. You will work in an environment characterized by collaboration, knowledge sharing, mutual respect, and a strong commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.

**What We Offer

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence both new projects and the continuous development of our production facilities. You will apply your technical expertise while collaborating with colleagues from different disciplines and helping to bring innovative solutions into operation.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Act as the automation specialist in engineering projects and production development activities.

• Provide technical guidance and support to automation technicians, maintenance teams, and project stakeholders.

• Verify and approve machinery and equipment according to applicable requirements and specifications.

• Support the commissioning, qualification, and maturation of new technologies and production equipment.

• Develop, review, and optimize automation solutions, including programmable logic controller programming and robotic applications.

• Participate in Factory Acceptance Tests and Site Acceptance Tests to ensure successful implementation.

• Contribute to initiatives involving industrial connectivity, manufacturing information technology systems, cloud-based solutions, servers, and standardized machine control concepts where relevant.

• Drive continuous improvements that enhance productivity, quality, safety, and operational stability.

**What You Will Bring

**You combine strong technical capabilities with a practical and structured approach to problem-solving. You enjoy working across disciplines and are motivated by transforming technical requirements into dependable production solutions.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a degree in engineering, automation, electronics, or another relevant technical discipline, or possess equivalent technical qualifications.

• Have around 5-10 years of experience within industrial automation, robotics, or manufacturing technology.

• Bring solid experience in programmable logic controller programming, preferably with Siemens TIA Portal.

• Have experience with robotics; knowledge of KUKA and/or Fanuc is considered an advantage.

• Have participated in commissioning activities, Factory Acceptance Tests, Site Acceptance Tests, and equipment qualification processes.

• Have experience with or interest in industrial connectivity, manufacturing information technology, cloud technologies, servers, and machine control standards.

• Communicate effectively in both Danish and English.

• Enjoy collaborating with diverse stakeholders and building strong working relationships across functions.

The position includes limited domestic and international travel, typically up to 20 days annually. Travel will primarily be within Europe.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect from our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All enquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof to transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees, and the planet through our foundations. With production companies and sales operations across the world, our products are widely available, and we are committed to creating better living environments through daylight and fresh air.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX, we believe in fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive, develop, and perform at their best. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and ways of thinking.

We recruit, hire, develop, and promote people based on skills, qualifications, and potential. We value diversity and inclusion because we know that different perspectives help us create better solutions, stronger teams, and a more innovative workplace.

**About The Job

**As a Medical Affairs Intern - Neurology, you will gain hands-on experience within the Medical Affairs team of a global pharmaceutical company, contributing to a research project that combines scientific literature reviews with insights from clinical experts.

You will have the opportunity to explore complex scientific topics, support research activities, and engage with healthcare professionals to better understand clinical practices and patient needs. Working closely with an experienced Medical Advisor, you will develop your scientific research, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills in a collaborative environment.

This internship may also provide an opportunity to connect your practical experience with your academic studies or Master's thesis, subject to university requirements and agreement.

Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Conduct structured scientific literature reviews to identify, assess, and summarise existing research findings.

• Assist in preparing and coordinating interviews with neurologists to better understand clinical practices and patient needs.

• Help gather, organise, and interpret insights from healthcare professionals, comparing findings with published scientific evidence.

• Prepare clear summaries, reports, and presentations to communicate research findings and project Progress.

• Collaborate closely with the Medical Affairs team and contribute to scientific discussions and ongoing project activities.

**About You

**To excel in this role you will need to have:

• Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Medicine, Neuroscience, Health Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Public Health, or a related discipline.

• Strong interest in Medical Affairs, scientific research, and gaining experience within the pharmaceutical industry.

• Ability to understand, critically evaluate, and summarise complex scientific information.

• Strong organisational skills, with a structured and systematic approach to research and project activities.

• Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence and willingness to engage with healthcare professionals and other stakeholders.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues.

• Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the confidence to engage in scientific discussions with healthcare professionals.

**Additional Experience That Would Be Beneficial

**

• Previous academic or practical experience involving multiple sclerosis, other neuroimmunological disorders, or patients living with these conditions.

• Experience conducting systematic literature reviews, qualitative research, and/or working with real-world data.

**About Sanofi

**We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

**Why choose us?

**

• Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you.

• Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare.

• Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve.

• Grow in a purpose-driven company where your voice matters and your work helps improve millions of lives.

• Thrive in inclusive, flexible workplaces that support your personal and professional well-being.

• Launch your career with a company that invests in you — and empowers you to reimagine what’s possible.

BEC is in the process of being acquired by our largest customer and co-owner, Nykredit, which is Denmark's largest mortgage provider and third-largest bank. We will become part of a new and larger organization called Nykredit Financial Technologies. In the transition phase, we are recruiting for roles that we expect to be highly needed in our future organization.

The role

As our Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own the processes and data behind our sales organization: the sales process, definitions, forecasting and commissions.

This is an individual contributor role in our Revenue Operations team, reporting to the Global Director, Revenue Operations & Information Security. You'll be supported by the RevOps team and work closely with sales leadership and Finance. We're looking for around 5+ years of hands-on experience in VC or PE-backed companies.

What you'll do

Forecasting

• Define shared sales terms and metrics such as pipeline, stage probabilities, bookings, and new versus expansion business.

• Establish a forecasting baseline: forecast categories, submission rules and a first method for new business and expansion.

• Track forecast accuracy and refine the method as data quality improves.

• Build pipeline and forecast reports and dashboards in Salesforce.

• Set up a pipeline and forecast review cadence with sales leadership once the definitions are in place.

Sales process

• Own the sales process from qualified opportunity to closed deal, including stages, exit criteria and the hand-over to delivery and Finance.

• Set up territories, account ownership and rules for partner and cross-sell deals.

Commissions

• Help automate the commission process with the right tooling, from data capture to calculation and payout.

• Work with Finance and sales leadership on plan design and changes.

Sales systems

• Shape how Salesforce (including Revenue Cloud/CPQ) supports the sales process, and make hands-on changes where needed.

• Keep sales data clean with required fields, validation rules and deduplication.

• Automate manual steps in the sales process with workflows and AI.

• Work with CRM vendors and implementation partners, including evaluations, renewals, support and new functionality.

• Train and support sales reps on system and process changes.

Stack harmonization

We grow through acquisition. In October 2026 we announced our combination with WoodWing, adding four products and more than 200 colleagues. Harmonizing the sales stack and processes of acquired companies is a big part of this job, done together with the RevOps team and the Global Director, Revenue Operations & Information Security.

• Bring each acquired sales team, starting with WoodWing, onto our shared sales process, pipeline stages, definitions and reporting.

• Move acquired sales reps onto group commission plans.

• Set account ownership and cross-sell rules between entities, and resolve duplicate accounts.

• Assess each acquired company's sales systems and migrate accounts, contacts, opportunities and products into Salesforce in phases, including from HubSpot.

• Build a repeatable playbook for the next acquisition.

Your qualifications

Essential

• Around 5+ years in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations in B2B SaaS

• Experience building a sales forecast from the ground up, including the definitions and data quality behind it

• Hands-on Salesforce experience, including reports, dashboards and flows

• Experience designing and rolling out sales processes

• Experience administering sales commissions

• Experience consolidating CRMs or sales processes after an acquisition, or running sales operations across several entities

• Good understanding of sales metrics such as pipeline coverage, win rates, sales cycle and bookings

• Strong analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets

Nice to have

• HubSpot experience, including migrating from HubSpot to Salesforce

• Salesforce Revenue Cloud or CPQ experience

• Experience implementing commission software

• Using AI in sales workflows

Soft skills

You're comfortable with change and ambiguity, as our processes keep developing with each acquisition. You build trust with sales leaders and sales reps, prefer practical solutions you can improve over time, and help new colleagues adapt to shared ways of working.

What kind of company is Omnidocs?

We recognize that in different phases of life, you need different kinds of flexibility, and we are happy to provide that. It could be that you prefer to work from home once or twice a week or occasionally need to leave early for a soccer tournament, a parents’ meeting, or a romantic date. We find small talk between co-workers valuable, so your lunch break is part of your working hours, and we invest in quality coffee beans for the cozy and useful interactions across teams by the coffee machine. It may sound like little things, but the overall message is that we want you to meet trust, kindness, and helpfulness at work because we expect that this is what you bring as well. The purpose of our company is just as internal as it is externally communicated: We make every workday work better.

We also love to connect. We do social activities such as LAN parties, board game afternoons, and Friday Cafes. Our office is located in the heart of the historic neighborhood of Christianshavn, surrounded by canals and great little cafés and restaurants. We have plenty of light and air while being close to everything – including the metro, the canals, and the city center.

****What will you be doing?

**

• Implement, maintain and refactor embedded C code for our ESW platforms and products

• Contribute to integration of new features and bug fixing across the full software stack

• Collaborate closely with other embedded developers on design, code reviews and troubleshooting

**To Thrive In This Role, You Should Possess

**

• 5+ years of C programming skills and experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, and RTOS

• 2+ years of professional experience with CI/CD pipelines for embedded software and AI-assisted workflows development

• Solid experience in navigating and contributing to large, complex codebases and SDKs from chip vendors

• Experience with Bluetooth wireless technologies – practical proficiency with Bluetooth Classic, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), and familiarity with LE Audio

• Experience in scripting and Automation (Python and Makefile)

• Fluent written and spoken English

**Beyond Your Technical Skills

**You are a curious, logical thinker who enjoys solving problems and thrives in a constant learning environment at the edge of technology. You like to combine active coding with building smart automation.

You manage your time effectively and work through issues through each stage, from analysis to implementation and automated quality assurance. Furthermore, you contribute positively to a shared goal where we succeed together as a team.

At GN we pride ourselves on encouraging flexible working whenever possible. We trust our people to fulfill their responsibilities, to know when in-person collaboration is better than hybrid, and to be present when it's needed most.

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link before 30 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact hiring manager Ole Gudiksen, ESW Platform, at olgudiksen@gn.group.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.

****About The Role

**Be part of the movement – and play your part

****About The Role

**DFDS operates through two divisions – Logistics and Ferry. In this role, you will join the central Business Finance team for the Logistics Division and take part in how financial performance is measured, steered, and improved across a rapidly growing European logistics business. You will report to the Head of Central Business Finance Logistics, who reports to the Divisional CFO Logistics.

The central Business Finance team holds ownership of all core financial planning, reporting, functional finance, and commercial support activities of the Logistics Division. You will join a team of four Finance Business Partners in Copenhagen and two Business Analysts in our Shared Service Center in Poznan.

**

• Driving the divisional monthly- and quarterly performance cycle, incl. reporting and budgeting

• Driving improvement initiatives for the reporting framework, automation and data quality

• Engaging in improvement initiatives in the data models, and planning frameworks relevant to the performance cycle

• Supporting the adoption of new KPI frameworks and models for risk assessment to the performance outlook

Further, you will work closely with the Group FP&A team and the Senior Finance Business Partners across business units to ensure aligned financial processes, shared standards, and timely reporting.

Your role will be hands on, performing reporting- and analytical activities, together with a team that sits at the centre of the division’s performance agenda.

You will be based at our headquarters in Copenhagen and join a driven and dedicated Business Finance team where colleagues work closely together, support each other, and take pride in driving clarity and impact for the business. The division has more than tripled in size in recent years, and the business finance function is at the core of driving performance in this setting.

**About You

**You thrive in a role that combines the recurrent periodic reporting activities with hands-on analytical work, contributing to the strategic direction for the division. With this in mind, we imagine that the ideal candidate brings:

• +2 years of experience within FP&A or Business Finance, preferably from large, international, or complex organisations

• Understanding of financial processes, planning cycles, P&L, balance sheet and cash flow

• Strong analytical skills and structured problem solving abilities

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• A collaborative mindset and strong personal drive

• Fundamental understanding of EPM or ERP systems (e.g., OneStream/HFM, D365/SAP/Oracle or similar)

• Experience with and/or interest in leveraging AI to improve reporting, analysis, and ways of working

• Experience in the logistics sector and project management is a plus, but not required

A degree in finance, economics, business administration, or similar is expected. Full professional proficiency in English is required.

We think the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills, and strong characters bring out the best in us all. And we cannot wait for you to join.

**Working at DFDS

****Join the movement and grow with us

**As part of the Logistics Division - a business that has tripled in size over recent years - you will be at the heart of major strategic transformation as the division works to develop its network and digitise a traditionally manual industry.

While you’re with us, we want you to develop. At DFDS, development happens first and foremost through real work. We will also offer training and support when needed.

We promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

**Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply now.

**If you think your personality, skills, and experience match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as we’re keen to meet candidates on an ongoing basis.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Jens Beck, Head of Logistics Finance Business Partnering, Central, at jenbeck@dfds.com.

**We look forward to hearing from you.

**This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.

**Job Description

**Danske Bank's Personal Customers business unit is undergoing a significant transformation, and a trusted, scalable data foundation is at the heart of it. As Senior Business Analyst in the Data and Insight cluster, you will sit at the intersection of business, data, and technology, helping commercial teams and system owners unlock real value from data. This is a role where your analytical thinking and collaborative approach will shape better banking experiences for customers across the Nordics.

**What You Will Be Doing

**You will join the Customer Engagement Individuals Tribe, a diverse group of around 160 colleagues spanning data, technology, design, and business roles, working across the Nordics, Lithuania, and India. Operating within one of our Data Foundation squads, you will work closely with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to ensure that high-quality, trusted data underpins the bank's Forward'28 strategic objectives and be part of driving the Strategic Change helping the bank become more proactive and personalized in our engagement with our customers. Your work will directly support sustainable golden-source data models and reliable data availability for downstream use cases.

In your day-to-day work, you will:

• Translate business logic and requirements into clear, sustainable data specifications

• Collaborate with business stakeholders, system owners, and data owners to prioritise activities

• Ensure thorough documentation and adherence to governance and compliance standards

• Support alignment with regulatory, security, and governance frameworks across the data domain

• Contribute to the bank-wide data agenda in line with the Forward'28 strategy

• Help drive the Strategic Change helping the bank become more proactive and personalized in our engagement with our customers

**About You

**

• 5+ years experience as a Business Analyst, Business and Functional Specialist, or in a similar role

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English

• Analytical mindset with comfort working in complex, changing environments

• Collaborative approach with the ability to bridge business and technical teams

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Engineering, Natural Sciences, or a related field

Familiarity with data analysis tools such as SQL or Excel, and experience with compliance, risk, or financial services data, would be a welcome addition. We value diverse backgrounds and perspectives, and if you meet most of the criteria above, we encourage you to apply.

**What We Offer You

**You will join a collaborative, cross-functional tribe where learning and development are part of everyday work. We operate on a hybrid model, with three to four days per week in the office in Copenhagen or Vilnius, supporting knowledge sharing and team connection. You will have the opportunity to grow your expertise in a domain that sits at the centre of Danske Bank's strategic direction, working alongside colleagues from a wide range of disciplines.

This position can be located both in Denmark and Lithuania (no relocation package included). If the position is located in Lithuania, the salary range will be from 3920 EUR to 5880 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job) and your job function (position) in the job contract will be Technology Business Solutions.

**Have we caught your attention?

**Apply now! We process applications continuously, so we encourage you to apply sooner rather than later.

For more information, please contact Hiring Manager Michael Friis Bak on mras@danskebank.dk or Cluster Lead Mikkel Winther mikkelw@danskebank.dk.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**We are looking for an FP&A Specialist to strengthen our Corporate FP&A team and take ownership of cash flow forecasting, balance sheet planning, working capital management, and other key planning activities below Adjusted EBITDA across the Group.

Reporting directly to the Head of FP&A, you will play a key role in advancing our financial planning capabilities and driving transparency across cash flow, liquidity, and balance sheet performance. You will work closely with Accounting, Tax, Controlling, regional Finance teams, and key business stakeholders to ensure robust planning processes and high-quality management reporting.

This is a unique opportunity to:

• Take ownership of the Group's cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital planning agenda, helping to improve cash generation and support management decision-making.

• Shape and develop our Workday Adaptive Planning capabilities, leading key initiatives to establish scalable planning models and reporting structures.

• Work across markets and functions, partnering with regional Finance teams and senior stakeholders to strengthen forecasting, reporting, and business insight throughout the organization.

The successful candidate will help establish best-in-class planning processes that connect P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow forecasting, providing management with greater visibility into liquidity, working capital performance, and long-term value creation. The role is a full-time role and reports to the Head of Group Financial Planning & Analysis.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own the Group's cash flow planning across forecast, budget, and long-range planning cycles.

• Drive the development of balance sheet forecasting capabilities and ensure alignment between P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow planning.

• Lead the implementation and continuous development of cash flow and balance sheet planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning.

• Define business requirements and partner closely with the BI Team to improve planning processes, reporting capabilities, and system functionality.

• Partner with Accounting, Controlling, Tax, and regional Finance teams to strengthen cash flow and balance sheet reporting, improve forecast accuracy, and establish clear ownership across planning activities.

• Develop and maintain monthly cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital reporting, including variance analysis, key risks and opportunities, and actionable management insights.

• Establish and maintain a clear RACI framework across Finance for balance sheet and cash flow planning, forecasting, and follow-up activities.

• Develop driver-based forecasting methodologies for key working capital metrics, including inventory, receivables, payables, and other material balance sheet accounts.

• Monitor working capital performance and identify opportunities to improve cash conversion and optimize working capital.

• Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Controlling to strengthen understanding of working capital drivers and improve forecast accuracy.

• Support Executive Management and Board reporting by providing insights on cash generation, liquidity, working capital performance, and financial risks and opportunities.

• Drive continuous improvement of forecasting methodologies, planning processes, and financial transparency across the organization.

• Support the ongoing development of FP&A capabilities by integrating balance sheet and cash flow considerations into strategic and long-range planning processes.

**WHO YOU ARE

**You are a curious and analytical finance professional with a passion for turning data into insights and helping the business make better decisions. You enjoy working across functions, building strong stakeholder relationships, and taking ownership of complex planning processes.

You thrive in a dynamic and growing environment and are comfortable navigating between operational details and the bigger picture. You enjoy driving improvements, challenging assumptions, and creating structure where it is needed.

You are comfortable working across Finance functions and partnering with regional Finance teams to improve forecasting, strengthen financial transparency, and drive continuous improvement. Most importantly, you are proactive, structured, and motivated by creating impact through high-quality financial planning and analysis.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 5+ years of experience within FP&A, Financial Controlling, Corporate Finance, or a similar role.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.

• Experience working with cash flow forecasting, working capital, balance sheet analysis, or investment planning.

• Solid financial modelling and analytical skills, including advanced Excel capabilities.

• Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning or other EPM/planning tools is an advantage.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• A proactive mindset and a passion for improving processes, systems, and ways of working.

• Experience from retail, hospitality, food & beverage, consumer goods, or other multi-site businesses is considered a plus.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

**Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

****ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**The opportunity

**Help define and advance the future of learning through Microsoft Viva Learning - enabling thousands of employees to build skills every day, in the flow of work.

We’re looking for a Learning & Development Product Consultant to lead key aspects of the firmwide deployment of Microsoft Viva Learning and help drive the end-to-end success of the platform. Working as a trusted partner to the Global Learning & Development Product Owner, senior Talent leaders, functional leads and regional teams, you will help shape strategic priorities, translate them into a practical roadmap, drive adoption at scale and deliver a modern, personalized learning experience aligned to business priorities.

As a global product consultant, you will sit at the heart of Talent, bringing together L&D, Technology and regional stakeholders to transform how learning is curated, delivered and experienced across the firm.

**

• Partner with the Global L&D Product Owner and functional leads to set direction, align priorities and advance Microsoft Viva Learning as a global learning platform

• Translate strategy into a clear roadmap, practical governance and measurable success outcomes

• Drive adoption, engagement and measurable business impact across a complex global stakeholder landscape

**

**Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

**Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our platform depends on accurate and timely data from custodians, banks, brokers, and other financial institutions. These connections provide the positions, transactions, cash movements, instruments, and corporate actions used throughout the investment-management lifecycle.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

**As our new Software Engineer, Investment Data Integrations 📈

**You will help build and operate the systems that connect Performativ with custodians and other providers of investment data.

The immediate challenge is practical: we need to deliver a growing number of integrations while maintaining the existing portfolio and resolving real production issues. The longer-term challenge is to avoid a scaling trap where every new institution requires another collection of manual processes and bespoke code.

We are building a more automated integration platform with reusable pipelines, mappings, reconciliation, quality controls, and AI-assisted development. Your work will contribute both to integrations customers need now and to the foundations that let the team deliver future integrations faster and more safely.

• You will develop and maintain integrations covering positions, transactions, cash, instruments, prices, corporate actions, and other investment data across files, APIs, SFTP, and message-based interfaces.

• You will build reusable ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and monitoring capabilities instead of treating each provider as an isolated implementation.

• You will investigate complex data and production issues across internal systems, external providers, and customer environments, then deliver permanent fixes that prevent known classes of problems from recurring.

• You will work closely with users, operations specialists, and other engineers to understand the complete workflow and ensure that integrated data is correct and useful throughout the platform.

• You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their assumptions and output critically, and establish the tests, controls, and evidence required for safe deployment.

You should bring strong backend or data-engineering judgment and experience with production systems where correctness and reliability matter. Experience with financial integrations, investment data, reconciliation, ETL pipelines, APIs, structured files, or regulated systems would be valuable. Familiarity with technologies such as Python, Golang, PHP, TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, AWS, and CI/CD tooling is useful, but experience with our exact stack is not essential.

**We value your passion 🔥

**At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

AI can help us understand formats, generate mappings, develop implementations, and test integrations faster. It does not replace financial-domain understanding, careful validation, or accountability for the resulting data.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

**What We Can Offer You 🌱

**

• Work on integrations at the centre of a production wealth-management platform.

• Solve difficult problems involving financial data, external systems, reconciliation, reliability, and operational workflows.

• Help create an AI-assisted approach to developing and maintaining integrations safely at scale.

• An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• Strong opportunities to deepen both your engineering capabilities and your understanding of investment management.

Board Intelligence is a technology and advisory firm on a mission to make boards more effective, and through them, build better businesses and benefit society.

Over twenty years we have established ourselves as the market leader in governance and board effectiveness, trusted by more than 80,000 directors, executives, and governance professionals globally, including across the Fortune 500, FTSE 100, and OMX 30. That trust has been earned through depth of insight, rigorous advisory work, and a track record that newer entrants simply cannot replicate.

We have invested in applied AI since 2020, well ahead of the market, and that early conviction has paid off. Our AI-powered platform and smart board advisor give us a competitive advantage that is widening, not narrowing. In 2024, K1 Investment Management, the leading B2B Enterprise SaaS investor, backed us to accelerate that position further. We are now growing fast, with a proven commercial model spanning both mid-market and enterprise, and a product suite that has become a necessary addition in high-stakes board environments.

The people joining us now will shape how we scale. We are deliberate about how we do that. Our founders and leadership team are deeply invested in keeping the culture that got us here: thoughtful, high calibre, and genuinely human. Ambition and balance are not in competition at Board Intelligence.

If you want to work at the intersection of AI and governance, on problems that matter at the highest level, this is a strong place to be.

Our Mission

We unleash the potential of organisations through the science of board effectiveness, building better businesses and benefitting society.

**The Role

**Juristic is a Danish legal tech company, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Copenhagen. Our platform brings four tools together on the same case data: Structure, Timeline, Flow and JuristIQ, our legal AI in chat and tabular formats.

Clients include PwC, Bird & Bird and Bech-Bruun. Juristic is now part of Board Intelligence, and we are bringing a new product to market. The work is led by our CTO, and we are looking for an AI Engineer to build it with them from the first line of code.

This is a zero-to-one role in a small team of four full-stack developers, a machine learning engineer and the CTO. You will write the code, sit in front of customers, and help decide what we build next.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and ship the AI capabilities at the core of a new product, from first prototype to production

• Own LLM-powered workflows end to end, such as document understanding, data extraction and agentic assistants

• Choose and integrate models and providers, and own the prompting, retrieval, evaluation and guardrails that make AI output reliable enough for legal and governance work

• Work directly with customers and the CTO to turn real problems into product decisions, and help own the product roadmap

• Lay the engineering foundations for the new product, including architecture, testing, observability and deployment, so it can scale

• Work with the wider Juristic and Board Intelligence engineering teams, and contribute to AI tooling shared across the suite

**Person Specification

**We are looking for a builder: an experienced AI engineer who has been a technical founder or an early employee at a startup, and who is ready to do it again.

Required Skills and Experience:

• At least four years of professional software engineering experience

• Experience as a technical founder or early employee at a startup, having built a product from the first line of code

• A track record of building and shipping AI or LLM-powered products to real users

• Practical experience with LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval and evaluating model output in production

• Strong engineering fundamentals across backend and frontend, with the judgement to move fast without leaving a mess behind

• A strong product mindset: you have worked directly with customers and owned a product roadmap

• Hungry, motivated and ready for another zero-to-one journey

• Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to haves:

Experience with our stack: TypeScript (Node.js and React) and Python

Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing and extraction from unstructured text

Experience building agentic systems, tool use or MCP integrations

Experience with search and retrieval infrastructure, such as Elasticsearch or vector databases

A background in legal tech, governance or B2B SaaS for professional users

What good looks like in this role:

• After three months: you know our customers, the product vision and the codebase, and you have shipped AI features that real users rely on

• After six months: the core AI capabilities of the new product are in production, backed by evaluations that show they are reliable, and you are acting on customer feedback

• After twelve months: the product is in market with paying customers, you are a trusted voice on the roadmap, and the AI foundations you built are reused across the Juristic and Board Intelligence suite

**How We Work

**We hire people who are expert at what they do. Once you join, you have the autonomy to shape how you work and the space to do it well. That doesn’t mean working in isolation. You’ll have colleagues who know their craft, regular collaboration across functions, and easy access to senior leadership when you need it.

We keep our structure flat. We work at pace in an agile, nimble environment where good ideas don’t wait for permission. If you spot something that could work better, we encourage you to say so. If you want to run with an idea, we’ll back you to do it.

We work with people who take pride in their output, back their team through the hard parts, and leave things better than they found them.

**What Happens Next

**Once you apply, our Talent team will review your application. If there’s a fit, they’ll be in touch to discuss the role and next steps.

**How We Use AI In Our Hiring

**We use AI responsibly, both in the software we build for governance teams and in how we hire. Our Talent team may use AI to support application review, CV analysis, or identifying areas that need further verification.

But hiring decisions are made by people. AI surfaces signals; people make the call on whether to progress a candidate or extend an offer.

If you’d like details on how your data is handled during recruitment, contact our Talent team.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

**We’re an equal opportunities employer. We’re building a team that works because it reflects a breadth of experience, background, and perspective.

Apply even if you don’t tick every box on the job specification. If the role excites you and you think you could make an impact, we want to hear from you.

We don’t discriminate on the basis of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of recruitment, or if there’s anything else we can do to make the process more accessible, tell our Talent team. We’ll sort it.

**Your Safety Matters

**Be cautious of unexpected messages claiming to be from Board Intelligence. We will never ask you for fees as part of recruitment. If you’re unsure whether a communication is genuine, contact our Talent team through our official channels before sharing information or clicking links.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.occupation: Laboratory Technician / Laboratory Manager – New Neuroscience Research Group at BRIC
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced, motivated and independent laboratory technician/laboratory manager to join a newly established research group at the Biotech Research and Innovation Centre (BRIC), University of Copenhagen, investigating the molecular mechanisms of synaptic plasticity.

  We particularly welcome applications from experienced laboratory technicians seeking a long-term role in a research group.

  As the first member of the new research group, you will work closely with the group leader to establish the laboratory from the ground up. The position combines hands-on experimental work with responsibility for laboratory organization and offers the opportunity to play a central role in shaping how the laboratory develops as the group grows. We hope to build a lasting working relationship with a colleague who enjoys taking ownership of laboratory operations and experimental methods.

  Information on the department can be found at: https://www.bric.ku.dk/

   

  Our research

  Our research aims to understand how neuronal connections respond and adapt to activity, with a particular focus on the local molecular mechanisms regulating synaptic function and plasticity. We are particularly interested in how RNA localization and local protein synthesis are spatially organized at synapses, and how these processes contribute to activity-dependent changes in neuronal connectivity.

  We combine molecular and cellular neuroscience with advanced imaging, transcriptomic and proteomic approaches to investigate these questions across different types of synapses, including conventional neuronal synapses and specialized synapses of the retina.

  We are establishing a new research group at BRIC and aim to build an ambitious, collaborative and supportive team with open communication, high scientific standards and shared responsibility. As the first member of the laboratory, you will have a unique opportunity to contribute to its development from the beginning.

   

  Your job

  You will work closely with the group leader during the initial establishment of the laboratory and, as the team expands, become a central technical and organizational point of contact for the group.

  Your tasks will include:

   	
• Helping establish the laboratory, including ordering systems, stocks, equipment, documentation and shared laboratory resources. 	
• Establishing, documenting and maintaining laboratory protocols, procedures and experimental workflows. 	
• Contributing to hands-on experimental work and supporting ongoing research projects. 	
• Implementing, optimizing and troubleshooting new experimental methods. 	
• Onboarding and training new students, postdoctoral researchers and other group members in laboratory procedures and experimental techniques. 	
• Helping ensure continuity in laboratory procedures, experimental workflows and technical knowledge as the group grows. 	
• Coordinating shared laboratory activities and contributing to an efficient, safe and well-organized research environment.   The position is expected to develop together with the research group. Initially, there will be a strong focus on establishing the laboratory and experimental workflows. As the team grows, the role is expected to increasingly combine hands-on research with laboratory coordination, training and technical support.

   

  Profile

  We are looking for a motivated, independent and collaborative colleague who enjoys taking responsibility and contributing to the development of a new research environment. Substantial hands-on laboratory experience, reliability and an interest in long-term technical stewardship are particularly valued; a PhD is not required.

  Essential experience and skills

   	
• Relevant training as a laboratory technician, biomedical laboratory scientist or equivalent, or comparable professional experience in a biomedical research environment. 	
• Demonstrated experience working independently in a biomedical research laboratory and taking responsibility for experimental workflows, laboratory procedures or shared laboratory activities. 	
• Broad practical laboratory experience and the ability to implement and troubleshoot experimental procedures. 	
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and follow tasks through to completion. 	
• Good communication and collaboration skills. 	
• A proactive and solution-oriented approach to laboratory work. 	
• An interest in sharing knowledge and training students and other researchers. 	
• Good written and spoken English.   Desirable experience and skills:

  Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage:

   	
• Laboratory organization or management, including ordering, stocks, equipment or shared laboratory resources. 	
• Establishing, documenting and troubleshooting experimental protocols. 	
• Molecular biology and RNA or protein biochemistry. 	
• Cell culture, including neuronal cell culture. 	
• Microscopy and imaging. 	
• Tissue processing and histological techniques. 	
• Experimental animal models. 	
• Experience working with neural tissue, particularly retinal tissue, would be an advantage   We do not expect you to have experience with all techniques used in the group. Training can be provided for the right person. We particularly value applicants who are interested in taking ownership of their role, developing new skills and growing with the research group while contributing to its long-term development. Applicants with extensive practical laboratory experience are encouraged to apply regardless of publication record.

   

  Place of employment

  The place of employment is at the Biotech Research and Innovation Centre (BRIC), Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. BRIC provides a dynamic and international

  We aim to create a supportive and highly collaborative research environment with open communication, high scientific standards and a strong sense of shared responsibility. The position offers considerable independence and the opportunity to develop a broad and central role as the research group grows.

   

  Terms of employment

  The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The starting date is 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  Employment as laboratory technician will be in accordance with the agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and OAO/HK STAT. The position is placed in salary group 4.

  Employment will be in accordance with the provisions of the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). The monthly salary will be based on the number of years of work experience (seniority) with the possibility to negotiate a salary supplement based on prior experiences and qualifications. The employer will pay an additional 18.07 % to your pension fund.

  Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2020.

   

  Questions

  For further information regarding the position, please contact Eva Kaulich, Associate Professor and Group Leader, BRIC, University of Copenhagen: eva.kaulich@bric.ku.dk

   

  Application

  Your application should be submitted in English and include:

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page).

Over twenty years we have established ourselves as the market leader in governance and board effectiveness, trusted by more than 80,000 directors, executives, and governance professionals globally, including across the Fortune 500, FTSE 100, and OMX 30. That trust has been earned through depth of insight, rigorous advisory work, and a track record that newer entrants simply cannot replicate.

If you want to work at the intersection of AI and governance, on problems that matter at the highest level, this is a strong place to be.

Our Mission

We unleash the potential of organisations through the science of board effectiveness, building better businesses and benefitting society.

**The Role

**Juristic is a Danish legal tech company, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Copenhagen. Our platform brings four tools together on the same case data: Structure, Timeline, Flow and JuristIQ, our legal AI in chat and tabular formats.

Clients include PwC, Bird & Bird and Bech-Bruun. Juristic is now part of Board Intelligence, and we are bringing a new product to market. The work is led by our CTO, and we are looking for an AI Engineer to build it with them from the first line of code.

This is a zero-to-one role in a small team of four full-stack developers, a machine learning engineer and the CTO. You will write the code, sit in front of customers, and help decide what we build next.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and ship the AI capabilities at the core of a new product, from first prototype to production

• Own LLM-powered workflows end to end, such as document understanding, data extraction and agentic assistants

• Choose and integrate models and providers, and own the prompting, retrieval, evaluation and guardrails that make AI output reliable enough for legal and governance work

• Work directly with customers and the CTO to turn real problems into product decisions, and help own the product roadmap

• Lay the engineering foundations for the new product, including architecture, testing, observability and deployment, so it can scale

• Work with the wider Juristic and Board Intelligence engineering teams, and contribute to AI tooling shared across the suite

**Person Specification

**We are looking for a builder: an experienced AI engineer who has been a technical founder or an early employee at a startup, and who is ready to do it again.

Required Skills and Experience:

• At least four years of professional software engineering experience

• Experience as a technical founder or early employee at a startup, having built a product from the first line of code

• A track record of building and shipping AI or LLM-powered products to real users

• Practical experience with LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval and evaluating model output in production

• Strong engineering fundamentals across backend and frontend, with the judgement to move fast without leaving a mess behind

• A strong product mindset: you have worked directly with customers and owned a product roadmap

• Hungry, motivated and ready for another zero-to-one journey

• Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to haves:

Experience with our stack: TypeScript (Node.js and React) and Python

Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing and extraction from unstructured text

Experience building agentic systems, tool use or MCP integrations

Experience with search and retrieval infrastructure, such as Elasticsearch or vector databases

A background in legal tech, governance or B2B SaaS for professional users

What good looks like in this role:

• After three months: you know our customers, the product vision and the codebase, and you have shipped AI features that real users rely on

• After six months: the core AI capabilities of the new product are in production, backed by evaluations that show they are reliable, and you are acting on customer feedback

• After twelve months: the product is in market with paying customers, you are a trusted voice on the roadmap, and the AI foundations you built are reused across the Juristic and Board Intelligence suite

**How We Work

**We hire people who are expert at what they do. Once you join, you have the autonomy to shape how you work and the space to do it well. That doesn’t mean working in isolation. You’ll have colleagues who know their craft, regular collaboration across functions, and easy access to senior leadership when you need it.

We keep our structure flat. We work at pace in an agile, nimble environment where good ideas don’t wait for permission. If you spot something that could work better, we encourage you to say so. If you want to run with an idea, we’ll back you to do it.

We work with people who take pride in their output, back their team through the hard parts, and leave things better than they found them.

**Once you apply, our Talent team will review your application. If there’s a fit, they’ll be in touch to discuss the role and next steps.

**We use AI responsibly, both in the software we build for governance teams and in how we hire. Our Talent team may use AI to support application review, CV analysis, or identifying areas that need further verification.

But hiring decisions are made by people. AI surfaces signals; people make the call on whether to progress a candidate or extend an offer.

If you’d like details on how your data is handled during recruitment, contact our Talent team.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

**We’re an equal opportunities employer. We’re building a team that works because it reflects a breadth of experience, background, and perspective.

Apply even if you don’t tick every box on the job specification. If the role excites you and you think you could make an impact, we want to hear from you.

The Department of Business Development and Technology (BTECH) at Aarhus BSS, Aarhus University invites applications for associate professorship positions in engineering.

An associate professorship is a full-time permanent position. The starting date is 1 September 2027 or as agreed upon.

Associate professors balance their time evenly between research and teaching activities. The successful candidates will join the EngTech research section.

Job description
We are looking for candidates who can strengthen our research profile. A significant part of our work involves collaboration with industry partners, and we often carry out applied research. Therefore, it is important that candidates conduct research on topics relevant to modern companies, and candidates with research activities involving industry will be preferred.

Research disciplines relevant to the position include:

• 
Mechanical or electrical engineering with a focus on energy systems

• 
Mechanical engineering with a focus on product management and/or product development

• 
Industrial engineering with a focus on operations management and/or supply chain management

Candidates are expected to teach and supervise students at all levels, including PhD students. Our portfolio of engineering study programmes consists of an MSc in Engineering (Technology Based Business Development) as well as two Bachelor of Engineering programmes in Forretningsudvikling (Business Development) and Global Management and Manufacturing. Teaching will primarily take place within these programmes, although teaching in our IT and business engineering programmes may also become relevant.

Permanent employment as associate professor at Aarhus BSS requires completion of, within a two year period, the supervision course and also the course Online and blended learning provided by Centre for Educational Development at Aarhus University.

Non-Danish speakers are required to acquire a working knowledge of Danish within the first 3 years of employment. Where relevant, the department will grant time off from teaching duties to attend Danish courses during the first two years of employment.

Your qualifications
Employment as an associate professor requires a PhD degree and a strong academic background as assistant professor or equivalent. Furthermore, we prefer applicants with the following qualifications:

• 
A proven record of strong international research, as evidenced by publications in highly reputed international journals.

• 
A track record of excellence in teaching on topics relevant to our study programmes.

• 
A clear, well-developed and viable strategy for future high-level research.

• 
A track record of good citizenship in the wider academic community, combined with a commitment to contributing to a vibrant work environment within our department.

• 
A commitment to sharing insights and knowledge with the broader society and to prioritising dialogue with practitioners.

• 
A commitment to providing teaching that equips students with relevant competences and fosters their ability to reflect critically on business topics.

• 
A willingness to engage in external research funding activities.

The required qualifications are elaborated below:
Applicants must have produced and published research in addition to their PhD thesis and must demonstrate continued academic development through research publications that go beyond the PhD thesis either thematically, theoretically, methodologically and/or empirically.

Applicants must have at least three articles published or accepted for publications in high-standard, international, peer-reviewed journals. A significant part must have been produced after completion of the PhD degree. Furthermore, substantial publications must have been produced within the previous five years.

Applicants must document significant teaching experience. They must therefore have taught several courses, preferably at different levels and across a range of topics. Five courses are normally considered a minimum requirement.

Applicants must have some experience in conducting research collaboration, research management and knowledge dissemination, possibly including editorial experience and participation in collaborative research projects.

Application deadline
4 January 2027

Place of work
Birk Centerpark 15, DK-7400 Herning

The evaluation process
Shortlisting is applied. This means that an appointment committee (assisted by the chair of the assessment committee) advises the head of department on which applicants possess the qualifications, competencies, experience and potential described above under “Your qualifications”, notably in fields with specific departmental research and teaching needs and in accordance with the faculty’s criteria and guidelines for evaluating candidates to permanent positions.

Through the shortlisting process, the head of department selects the applicants who will receive a thorough assessment of their professional qualifications. The applicants will then be assessed by an expert assessment committee. All applicants will be notified whether or not their application has been shortlisted and forwarded to the assessment committee for evaluation. Shortlisted applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee.

Please note that the assessment of applicants is based solely on the material received prior to the application deadline.

Read more about the recruitment process, shortlisting procedure and guidelines for assessment committees here.

Further information

For further information about the position and the department, please contact Section Head Mirko Presser, tel. +45 3049 0976; email: mirko.presser@btech.au.dk.

If you need help uploading your application or have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Coordinator, Charlotte Thomsen, tel.: +45 8716 5362; email: charlotte@au.dk.

Who we are

BTECH is part of Aarhus BSS, Aarhus University – a top-100 university. Aarhus BSS has achieved the triple-crown AASCB, AMBA and EQUIS accreditations. BTECH is located in the business-oriented and entrepreneurial city of Herning. The department excels in business, IT and engineering disciplines and emphasises the importance of company collaborations.

We have around 1,200 students and close to100 staff members. Each year, approximately 500 students engage in company projects across more than 250 companies, ranging from SMEs to leading multinationals. Our student incubator, Business Factory, launches ca. 10 new companies annually.

We influence society through business development and technology. For this reason, many research projects are carried out in close collaboration with industry, based on new data and emerging technologies. These projects receive generous support from the ERC, Horizon Europe, the Independent Research Fund Denmark and the Danish Industry Foundation, among others.

More information about BTECH is available here.

International applicant? 
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information here:
https://internationalstaff.au.dk/relocationservice/

Please find more information about research opportunities at Aarhus University here: http://international.au.dk/research/

Terms of employment
Salary and terms of employment are governed by the Cirkulære om overenskomst for akademikere i staten (in Danish). You will be employed as asssociate professor at base pay level 4–8 with additional supplements in accordance with the Cirkulære om protokollat om visse ansættelsesvilkår for videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter (in Danish).

The job content and qualification requirements are described in further detail in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

Application procedure
When you apply for this position it is mandatory to attach the following:

• 
Application

• 
Curriculum Vitae. You are encouraged to declare any periods of leave without research activity, including, for example, maternity leave, since your research activities are assessed in relation to your actual research time

• 
Education (diploma for master's, PhD and possibly higher doctoral degree)

• 
List of publications (the enclosed publications must be clearly marked on the list of publications)

• 
Publications. Up to five publications can be included in the application. In the event of several authors the publications must be accompanied by a co-author statement concerning the applicant's share of the collaborative work with the consent of the co-authors. This template may be used for the purpose

• 
Teaching portfolio. The specific requirements regarding the documentation can be found here

Materials which cannot be uploaded together with the application may be submitted in five copies to Aarhus BSS HR & PhD, Aarhus University, Bartholins Allé 16, DK-8000 Aarhus C.

Read more about how to apply for an academic post at Aarhus BSS here

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

About Aarhus University

Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. • Consolidate and analyse large datasets from HighStage, Excel and other business applications.

• Translate sales pipeline and program data into useful input for operational planning, forecasting and decision-making.

• Identify gaps and inconsistencies in our data and develop practical ways of improving data quality.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data & Reporting department. The department is responsible for business intelligence, integrations, and the machine learning and AI that run in production across the company.

You will be joining a small experienced team with different responsibilities on our platform, all owning a part of the setup.

About your role

Your focus will be on building and orchestrating data pipelines in Azure Data Factory and Databricks.

You will:

• Build, orchestrate and maintain data pipelines in Azure Data Factory and Databricks

• Ingest data from a broad range of source systems and land it reliably in our Data Lakehouse

• Write the SQL and Spark transformations that turn raw data into trusted, documented datasets

• Monitor, troubleshoot and improve pipelines already running in production

• Take ownership of data quality, lineage and documentation for the pipelines you build

• Work with the platform around the pipelines, including Unity Catalog, Event Hubs and Service Bus

• Collaborate with the colleagues who build our reporting and ML solutions on top of your data

You will work independently on your own tasks, with close sparring from experienced colleagues.

About you

SQL is your native language. It is the tool you reach for first, and you read, write and reason about it without thinking twice. You also:

• Have hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks or similar pipeline and orchestration tools

• Know Python well enough to read, understand and modify code with confidence. You do not need to write it effortlessly

• Have worked with Spark or are keen to learn it

• Understand what Power BI and message-based technologies such as Service Bus are used for

• Work in a structured way, take ownership of what you build and are eager to learn

• Communicate comfortably in English. Danish is a plus but not a requirement

How we work with AI

Many of us use AI every day, and it is up to each person how much they use it. But we do not vibe-code our way into production. Code that goes live is code we understand, review and stand behind, and it meets our deployment standards like everything else. That is exactly why we need someone who can read and reason about code themselves instead of relying on a tool to do it for them.

• Real pipelines in production from early on, with experienced colleagues to spar with

• A modern Azure data platform where you can influence how it develops

• A culture based on trust, responsibility and collaboration, where your ideas are taken seriously
